t_advice_summary_textbox.text: You can choose the same side gnome but that doesnt always determine the number of mushrooms

vb_textbox.text: It is useful that when it lands on +5, to choose the tall gnome and when it lands on +1 to choose the short gnome.  I found that this would give you the most mushrooms in the forest.  If you start getting a low number of mushrooms in the forest, i would then swap the theory around
